'''Borgorp''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Exchange]] boss who was active on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he was known for his cruel personality. He was killed, alongside other Exchange bosses and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] leaders, by an individual in his [[Mandalorian outpost (Jundland Wastes)|outpost]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="Encounter" />
